build_mimelite_server: build a MIMELite federated learning server with a global model and optional channel
create_server_config: create a SyncMimeLiteServerConfig dataclass to configure MIME aggregation and optimizer settings
broadcast_to_clients: broadcast the global model and server optimizer state to selected FL clients
compute_gradient_average: compute the weighted average gradient across all selected clients for the current round
run_server_step: run a server step that updates the optimizer state and aggregates client model updates
